headline: Tinubu seeks N3.15tn cut in 2026 budget, retains N31.46tn deficit
summary: President Tinubu asked the House to cut the 2026 budget from N68.32tn to N65.18tn, retaining the N31.46tn deficit. He cited existing obligations and available resources.
why: Nigeria's federal budget sets public spending and borrowing needs for Africa's largest economy, shaping its fiscal outlook, naira-denominated debt and investor sentiment toward its sovereign bonds.
